description: Returns tasks assigned to the authenticated user. Use when the user asks 'what tasks do I have?', 'show me my tasks', 'what am I working on?', or 'list my assigned tasks'. Supports optional search, status, and assignee filters. Requires TaskManagement feature.

limit.description: Maximum tasks to return. Defaults to no limit.

search.description: Filter tasks by title or description.

status.description: Filter by task status (e.g. Open, InProgress, Done).

name: list_my_tasks

tasks.description: Array of task objects (id, title, projectName, status, dueDate, priority, estimatedHours, consumedHours)

title: My Tasks
